rules.statement: A condition precedent to the appointment of a legal representative under section 7 of the Mortgage Ordinance (Cap. 74) is that evidence should be tendered that the value of the mortgaged property does not exceed Rs. 2,500.
rules.supporting_quote: "A condition precedent to the appointment of a person to represent the estate of a deceased mortgagor under section 7 of the Mortgage Ordinance (Cap. 74) is that evidence should be tendered that the value of the mortgaged property does not exceed two thousand five hundred rupees."
